units.source_text: Usual starting dose: two Akeega 100/500 mg tablets once daily, plus prednisolone 10 mg daily. Continue your hormone injections unless you have had surgical castration. Treatment is continuous, with no routine rest week.

units.source_text: Take Akeega whole with water at least two hours after food, then wait at least one hour before eating. Take prednisolone with food. If a dose is missed, take it as soon as possible on the same day; do not take extra tablets. Check with the team after vomiting. The two Akeega strengths are not interchangeable.

units.source_text: Blood count: weekly in month 1, fortnightly in months 2-3, then monthly to year 1 and every two months thereafter. Liver tests: fortnightly for months 1-3, then monthly to year 1 and every two months thereafter. Blood pressure: weekly for two months, then monthly to year 1 and every two months thereafter. Potassium: monthly to year 1, then every two months.

units.source_text: Do not stop prednisolone suddenly, including when Akeega is held. Ask about steroid cover during illness. Dose reductions differ for low blood counts and liver injury; always follow the exact tablet strength and number on the revised prescription. Use condoms with a pregnant partner, or condoms plus another effective method with a partner who could become pregnant, during treatment and for four months after the last dose.
